description: Married beneficiary filing separately who lived with the spouse during the year, MAGI 120,000: the separate table jumps straight to its second row.
worked:
Premium year 2026; the income-related adjustment uses MAGI from the 2024 tax return (two years back): 120,000 (adjusted gross income plus tax-exempt interest).
CMS 2026 Medicare Parts A & B premiums fact sheet, Part B table, the table for beneficiaries who are married and lived with their spouses at any time during the year but file separate tax returns: 120,000 is greater than 109,000 and less than 391,000.
Part B: standard premium 202.90 + income-related adjustment 446.30 = total monthly premium 649.20.
Part D table, same row: monthly income-related adjustment 83.30 (added to the plan premium).
